hero.headline: Local ideas. World Economic Forum backing. Real impact on Valencia.
hero.intro: We are a volunteer-run hub of young people turning Valencia's most pressing challenges into projects that work — connected to a network of hubs the World Economic Forum supports in over 150 countries.

about.title: A civic engine run by Valencia's own young people
about.body1: The Valencia Hub is part of the Global Shapers Community, an initiative of the World Economic Forum bringing together people aged 18–33 who are already active in their cities. Every member volunteers their time alongside their studies or job.
about.body2: We choose local problems — housing, climate, mobility, education — and design projects with the people affected by them, using the training, network, and visibility the global community provides.
about.point1Body: No one draws a salary. Every hour comes from members' own time.
about.point2Body: Every Shaper is between 18 and 33 and leads their own projects.
about.point3Body: Projects are designed with and for Valencia's neighbourhoods.
about.point4Body: Backed by hubs and resources in over 150 countries.

wef.eyebrow: Our connection to the World Economic Forum
wef.title: One thread, from Geneva to your street
wef.body: The Valencia Hub is an officially recognised chapter of the Global Shapers Community, the World Economic Forum's youth initiative. That affiliation gives us training, funding opportunities, and a seat at conversations that shape global policy — which we bring straight back to Valencia.
wef.node1Sub: Sets the global agenda and convenes leaders in Davos and beyond
wef.node2Sub: The Forum's network of young civic leaders, founded in 2011
wef.node3Sub: Over 450 city-based hubs on every continent
wef.node4Sub: Our chapter, driving projects across the city

social.title: Stay close to what we're building

team.title: The people behind the hub
team.teaserBody: A small volunteer committee coordinates the hub day to day — projects, partnerships, communications, and the books — while every one of our Shapers leads work of their own.

projects.title: Projects, from idea to impact
projects.teaserBody: From neighbourhood orchards to post-flood rebuilding, our projects move from a Shaper's idea to something people can point to. Some are finished, some are running now, others start soon.

ctaBand.title: Valencia needs more people who build.
ctaBand.body: If you're between 18 and 33 and want to turn your energy into projects that matter, the hub is looking for you.

footer.about: The Valencia Hub is a volunteer-run chapter of the Global Shapers Community, an initiative of the World Economic Forum, building local projects with global backing.
footer.membershipNote: Global Shapers Valencia is an independent, volunteer-led hub of the Global Shapers Community, a World Economic Forum initiative. It is not a legal or financial affiliate of the World Economic Forum.
footer.rights: Global Shapers Valencia Hub. Community-built, volunteer-run.
